# Junior DevOps Engineer

Company: Harbor Point Software
Location: Columbus, OH

Harbor Point Software builds scheduling and tracking tools for regional freight carriers. Our
four-person platform team keeps those tools fast, safe and easy to ship. We are looking for
someone with 1-2 years of experience in DevOps, SRE or platform work.

## What you will do

- Maintain and improve the CI/CD pipelines used by our product teams
- Manage cloud infrastructure as code and review changes with the team
- Package and deploy services, and keep their dashboards and alerts healthy
- Take part in a weekly on-call rotation, with support from senior engineers

## Must have

- Hands-on experience with AWS (ECS, S3, IAM)
- Experience building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or a similar tool
- Infrastructure as code with Terraform
- Containers with Docker
- Scripting in Python or Bash
- Packaging and deploying services with Helm

## Nice to have

- Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring and alerting
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or higher
- Experience with an on-call rotation

## Details

- Salary range: $72,000-$88,000 per year
- Hybrid: 2 days per week on site in Columbus
- We cannot sponsor work visas for this role.
- Recruiter contact: talent@harborpoint.example
- Harbor Point Software is an equal opportunity employer.
